title: PNP manhunt for Gerald Bantag continues after failed poultry farm raid

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) pressed on its manhunt of former Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) chief Gerald Bantag after an unsuccessful operation to arrest him in a poultry farm in Ifugao. PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said on Monday, “We will not allow the passage of time or repeated attempts to evade arrest to weaken our resolve.” “Every lead will be pursued, every lawful opportunity will be acted upon, and we will not stop until they are brought before the courts to answer for the charges against them,” he added.
